sentences.en: What is the difference between imitation and real diamonds?
sentences.zh: 仿钻和真钻有什么区别？

sentences.en: On examination the jewel proved to be an imitation.
sentences.zh: 经过检查，这颗宝石是假货。

sentences.en: It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
sentences.zh: 与其在模仿中成功，不如在原创中失败。
